## Ways to Get Involved

::: {.card-custom}
## Volunteer
Lend your time and energy to ODA's work in Owo/Ose. Whether it's community outreach, event support, or campaign efforts, every hand helps drive real changes.
:::

:::{.card-custom}
### Donate
Your contribution directly supports ODA's initiatives - from the back-to-school bursary program to community development projects across Owo/Ose.
:::

::: {.card-custom}
### Spread the Word
Help us reach more people - share ODA's mission with your friends, family,and community,and follow our updates on social media.
:::
